sae.bar: usable iff loss_recovered>=0.70 and L_sae < L_floor_ctxmean (Andrej)

thresholds.random_percentile: >=95 vs ~10 matched controls (so must beat all of them)
thresholds.real: usable && distinct>=5 && label_holds_heldout && random_percentile>=95 && absent_in_random_init; null never passes

method.ablation: top-6 held-out windows per feature ranked by its max act on context tokens (outside centre 8x8 tube); block-16 edit x -> x - a_f(x) * W_dec[f] * norm_scale on context tokens (a_f from the SAE on the context-only block-16 acts; SAE error kept); context-only encoder blocks 17-24 + predictor, centre 8x8 tube target; effect = mean over target tokens of 1 - cos(pred_edit, pred_clean)
method.controls: 10 per candidate, nearest live non-candidate features in z-scored (log10 freq, log10 decoder_norm_raw*mean_act), needing >= 6 held-out firing windows; disjoint, pooled = 100; each control ablated on its OWN top windows
method.labels: features/score_contact/feature_XXXXX.png (train top-8 clips vs held-out top-8) + viz/ + positional stats of top-100 per split
method.random_init: absent_in_random_init = freq_random < 0.1 * freq_trained (held-out tokens; SAE inference threshold; trained-SAE norm constants)

notes: real=false for every feature tonight: absent_in_random_init is null by ruling (random-init comparison confounded: random-model block-16 acts have ~0.44x the norm and the trained SAE fires ~1,695 latents/token on them vs 31.7). Needs own normalisation or an SAE trained on random-init acts.
No candidate beat all 10 of its matched controls (random_percentile>=95 needs that). Closest: 3446 and 224 at 90th (each beaten by 1 control); 3574 at 100th but has no label that holds.

Ablation effects are tiny for every feature, candidates and controls alike: mean 1-cos on masked-region predictions 1e-8..2e-4 (rel L2 change 1e-4..2e-2). Removing one SAE latent at block 16 barely moves the predictor. Effect scales with edit size (sparse near-threshold features ~1e-8). Computed in float64 after the fp32 forward; values ~1e-8 are near fp32 noise and their ranking is not meaningful.

8 of 10 labels are positional/temporal (last tubelet t=7, fixed rows), not semantic; only 270 (robot gripper/wrist) is content-like. Positional features may well survive a proper random-init check (RoPE/position structure), so treat them sceptically even if ablation passes later.

Windows were selected from the full-video parquet acts, but the edit runs on the context-only pass; 27/660 feature-windows had the feature not firing on any context token in that pass (effect 0 by construction), mostly near-threshold sparse features. Left in, applies equally to candidates and controls.

Controls: 10 per candidate, disjoint (100 total), nearest in z-scored (log freq, log decoder_norm*mean_act) among features with >=6 held-out context-firing windows; each ablated on its own top-6 held-out windows. With only 10 controls the percentile resolution is 10 points.
Labels judged by Andrej from features/score_contact (train top-8 clips vs held-out top-8 clips) plus top-100 (t,h,w) stats per split. Strict: no-pattern -> false.
